name: Young Crab

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.limits: Crab anatomy throughout; speech by mouthpart movement with eyestalk and claw gestures. No clothing, no face added to the carapace.

gender_note.quote: an old Crab took the opportunity of saying to her daughter
gender_note.note: Sourced (not inferred). characters/index.json lists gender 'unspecified' — reported in qa/defects/DEF-p3-appearance-201.json.

base_age_note.reason: 'Young' and a daughter are sourced; persona band kept for voice casting (a grown young woman's voice). As an animal: a young adult crab, clean and bright-shelled.

hair.color: bright coral-orange to salmon-brown pie-crust carapace, cream underside
hair.style: clean, smooth, glossy and wet; no barnacles
hair.reason: Species; a lighter, younger version of her mother's shell.

eyes.expression: eyestalks swivelled away from her mother, impatient
eyes.quote: “Hold your tongue, Ma!” said the young Crab, a little snappishly.

face.shape: front of the carapace with mouthparts below the eyestalks
features: sharp snapping claw gesture as she answers back

build.posture: turns side-on away from her mother, claws tucked; sidles off
build.scale_reference: On the bank with the shrunken Alice (SUP-003); smaller than her mother.

entry_state.state: on the bank with the party, wet from the pool
entry_state.quote: all dripping wet, cross, and uncomfortable

marks.description: black-tipped claws, snapped once as she says 'Hold your tongue, Ma!'
marks.reason: Species; gesture designed from the sourced snappishness.

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: she wears nothing; her look is the bright coral shell
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives her no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old dress, snood and mitts are dropped.

pair_rule: See CHAR-old-crab pair_rule: same species; daughter smaller, brighter and clean-shelled.
prompt_base_en: photoreal young edible crab on a muddy pool bank, bright coral-orange pie-crust carapace clean and glossy wet, black-tipped claws tucked, small black eyes on stalks turned away impatiently, standing side-on, natural crustacean anatomy, macro live-action film plate
